description: Delete a task (task managers of the project: its owner, the workspace owner or a workspace admin, the project lead or members with the tasks:manage right; a global admin role does not count). To clean up, archive instead: update_task with status "archived" keeps the task and only hides it from lists. Deleting moves it to the deleted list (restore_task brings it back) and is capped at 10 per person in 10 minutes.

task.description: Task Mongo id or task number such as ZERO-41
